Chronicle Note Asmita & Friend ✨

For Asmita

Because birthdays deserve to be celebrated properly.

Hey Asmita,

I know you’ve said before that you don’t really like your birthday or get super excited for it. But I wanted to make sure that this year, you get a reminder of how much of a positive, lighthearted, and genuine presence you are to the people around you.

From 9 PM sleep routines to having each other pinned right at the top of our chat lists, having you around as a friend has been awesome. You bring so much bright energy and effortless humor into everyday conversations.

You deserve a year ahead full of happiness, good health, peace of mind, and endless funny moments.

Happy Birthday, Asmita! Keep being your awesome self. ✨

Always supporting you, Your Friend ✨
